title: This American Life
author: This American Life
description:
This American Life is a weekly public radio show, heard by 2.2 million people
on more than 500 stations. Another 2.5 million people download the weekly
podcast.

title: FLOSS Weekly (Audio)
author: Leo Laporte (distro@twit.tv)
description:
We're not talking dentistry here; FLOSS all about Free Libre Open Source
Software. Join host Doc Searls and his rotating panel of co-hosts every
Wednesday as they talk with the most interesting and important people in the
Open Source and Free Software community. Records live every Wednesday at
12:30pm Eastern / 9:30am Pacific / 16:30 UTC.
